components.css: .ds-weekly-calendar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-weekly-calendar button{display:flex;min-width:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--ql-line,#dce6ef);border-radius:10px;text-align:left;background:#fff;color:var(--ql-ink,#172840);cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease}.ds-weekly-calendar button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--ql-accent,#245ce5);background:#edf3fb}.ds-weekly-calendar strong{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}.ds-weekly-calendar span,.ds-weekly-calendar small{color:var(--ql-muted,#52677d);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.ds-weekly-calendar button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #79a3ff;outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-weekly-calendar button:hover{background:#f1f6fc}}@media(max-width:850px){.ds-weekly-calendar{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:580px){.ds-weekly-calendar{gap:8px}.ds-weekly-calendar button{padding:12px;gap:6px}.ds-weekly-calendar strong{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-weekly-calendar button{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-weekly-receipt{margin-top:28px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--ql-line,#dce6ef);color:var(--ql-ink,#172840);font:400 13px 'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-weekly-receipt h4{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}.ds-weekly-receipt dl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;margin:18px 0}.ds-weekly-receipt dt{color:var(--ql-muted,#52677d);margin-bottom:6px}.ds-weekly-receipt dd{margin:0}.ds-weekly-receipt p{font:12px/1.7 var(--font-geist-mono,monospace);overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-weekly-receipt details{margin-top:18px;line-height:1.7}.ds-weekly-receipt summary{padding-block:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:650;color:#294b78}.ds-weekly-receipt summary:hover{color:var(--ql-accent,#245ce5)}.ds-weekly-receipt summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ql-accent,#245ce5);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: Help Spanish-speaking researchers understand and complete a prediction tournament. Public pages introduce the research workflow; authenticated screens prioritize the next action, readable records and explicit states. Functionality and scientific accuracy govern visual decisions.
